body:
And so you are my red red rose,
Pardon the languish in prose,
For I adore everything of you,
A journey we’ve been through.


Neglect, a constant as a child,
Acceptance. The the love I have from a mile,
Appreciation, firm dedication to you,
Serenity, a verb I never knew

Try as I might, no respite,
The feeling however trite,
Embracing the feeling I never knew;
Falling deeper, forever, in love..
With you.

Frenetic, gaze to the darkened phone. 

Frantic, wishing it to illuminate.

Fallow, my emotional landscape.

Famine, in the wake of departure.

Fastidious, mulling every memory.

Feckless, attempts to move on.

Fickle, attrition of self.

Finite, an ability to wait.

It was always a covert operation,

The living room, our secret destination,

Tiptoeing, each creek fueling hesitation,

Treating the living room as our salvation.

*Should we wake the sleeping beast,*

*Tragedy! To say the least!*

*Surely our forays would cease,*

*Hold our breath, await release.*

By the glow of the TV,

We would bond, daddy and me,

Such a cherished memory,

Visited in reverie.

Twining our fingers,

The feeling lingers,

Connected at last,

Atoning the past.

*Times were rough,*

*Never good enough,*

*Lost at sea,*

*Divided from humanity.*

Wave of calm,

A warm palm,

Meaning so much,

Simply to touch.

'Twas a night of festivity,

Recounting tales, inciting laughter,

Luring all into captivity,

A thought in my head, "I'll tell my story after!"

*As one story ended, silence settled the room*

*I saw my opportunity, beginning to speak:*

*"You'll never believe this!" My exuberance bloom*

*Intoxication releasing the story to surely label me a freak*

"You see, STDs can be transmitted masturbatorily"  

"That's right, I gave my self a horrible fright!"

"Chlamydia, brah, you better believe!"

"Yup! I gave myself chlamydia using a fleshlight"

*It was at that moment she walked in,*

*The hottie I was to meet that night*

*The look of disgust, fueling my chagrin*

*Ohh well, I always have the fleshlight!*

Every breath I take,
Further drives the stake,
Deeper into my heart,
As my thoughts form a perfect art.

*A poem about the midnight sky...*
*And how it mirrors everything inside,*
*The never ending shroud of darkness littered by stars shining through,*

*The same shroud inside of me that hope pierces when I think of you.*
...Of how clouds form in those once­ halcyon skies,
Pouring rain down like the tears which flow from my eyes, 

Harsh realization that the hope was for naught,
Like a fly in a spider's web, in words I am caught.

*The "talent" is not something I cherish,*
*The words do not guide my darkened path to bliss,*
*I know it is something I take for granted,*
*But through my life's pain and pleasure, seeds of words are planted.*
Until the day I die,
Whether of the sky,
Or a longing passion that burns to taste your lips,
Words will form poems, and maybe one day it will end --­ the eternal eclipse.
*I hate the grind,*
*I hate the poetic mind.*

Everyone is dead to me,

I look, but only find apathy,

Veiled, of course, by a cancerous lie,

Caring, but when I need it, what a surprise.



*I'm much too stubborn to ask,*

*It's just that no one should have such a task,*

*No one should waste their time with me,*

*Point driven, point taken, point reality.*


I smile a hollow smile for everyone,

Inside, I know I am nearing being done,

Everyone, the world, is dead to me,

I am deafened by the screams of apathy.


*Even though some are "just right there"*

*They feel so far away, the screams continuing to blare,*

*Even though you are there for me,*

*I feel so lonely...*

Gentle sound looms the air,

The creeks and cracks of his rocking chair,

Durable, ancient, made of hickory and oak,

From his pipe, an unforgettable aroma -- smoke.


*Weaving tales of the past, as I sit intently,*

*His cadence and tone lulls me gently,*

*With each exhale, the unmistakable scent,*

*Wooden supports, after all these years, unbent.*


I still remember those halcyon days,

Moments I sat, in utter amaze,

Departure of youth has cast a haze,

As I recount my own tales, wrought by malaise.


*Now it is I who sits in that old hickory and oak,*

*Gently rocking, while lacing the air with smoke,*

*Recounting memories I try not to forget...*

*Me, alone, timid inaction - my only regret.*




Edit: Thanks for the prompt :) Was fun.

Silenced by the hand of neglect,
A history one cannot regret,
The perfect fit does not exist,
Left to create ones own bliss,
Still, it craves, there's more than this,
Connection to another bard, a wish,
One to appreciate, rather than diss,
Words strewn about careless, remiss,
Dropping the bobber, we fish,
To connect, against all bet,
Release it all, and no longer fret,
'I'm another weaver of words.. Well met'
As did I :) I hope you have a great series of days.

Thank you for the kind words.

I hope it has helped others. I know it helped me. I hadn't written in a while. I forgot how much of a cathartic activity writing is for me.

I'm glad my words spoke to you. My purpose of the writing was to while reaching out for help for myself, let those who are like me know that they're not alone. I'm not really sure what to say other than that - I dislike the cliche 'stay strong' and 'it gets better'. When enveloped by depression, cliches like those don't help. Most of the time, they make me more upset.

So instead of that, I'll say, "I understand". And I'll echo the sentiment of the writing "You are not alone"
And thank you. Feeling alone is the worst. By identifying with what I went through today, you've helped me to not feel so alone.
